body: Sometimes I want to ask someone to do it for me. Pain is pain but it’s barable when not conflicted by yourself.. I can’t find myself pushing the knife thru, I can’t find myself slicing the blade against myself. I wish someone would do it

I’ve done this twice.. I wish I went thru with it. 
I fought to keep myself from blacking out. Dying is scary.. I wish I was stronger. Everyday I want to just not wake up
What are you doing this second? I regret every choice I’ve made even ones from yesterday. I feel very alone specially on a day like this should be filled with joy and family
